# `⊗` — Outer product

Keys: `Alt-o m`

`X g⊗Y` applies `g` to every pair. Two atoms call `g` directly. Array arguments supply the result shape `⍴X , ⍴Y`.

```bpl
5+⊗5               ⍝ 10
5+⊗⊂5              ⍝ ⊂10
1,⊗2               ⍝ 1 2
1 2+⊗10 20         ⍝ [11 21 ⋄ 12 22]
⍳3 =⊗ ⍳3           ⍝ [$t $f $f ⋄ $f $t $f ⋄ $f $f $t]
```

Array frames collect pair results as items. See [inner product](dot.qmd).

## Inverse

With either argument fixed, `X f⊗⁻¹ Y` gives the argument whose outer product with `X` is `Y`.

```bpl
1 2 +⊗⁻¹ 1 2+⊗10 20   ⍝ 10 20
```
